summary: When you are feeling a lot, more attention, advice, help, or generosity can become overwhelming surprisingly fast.
body: When you are feeling a lot, more attention, advice, help, or generosity can become overwhelming surprisingly fast. When the Moon conjuncts Jupiter, emotions expand along with everyone’s desire to respond, which can turn one need into a flood of messages, visitors, opinions, spending, or promises. More support is not automatically better support. Decide what would actually make the situation easier before everyone else decides for you.
